description: Two bedroom apartment with River views of the Tyne, balconies face north and west. Neutrally decorated throughout with beige carpets in bedrooms and living room, kitchen and bathroom have vinyl and hallway is laminate. Kitchen has under counter separate fridge and freezer, washing/ dryer, electric hob and oven. Kitchen units are oak effect. bathroom has white suite with shower over bath. Storage cupboard. Allocated parking. Bike store. Alarmed. A number of children's play areas across the development. Approx 15 mins walk to Quayside and buses every 10 mins to Newcastle City. Good access to A1, N&S. Unfurnished.
